claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord + passive mechanics family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no 'species_trait' kind. types.ts defines UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord — species traits are wholly absent. Darkvision is also always-on with no activation, no resource, no reset; no existing mechanics family can represent a permanent passive grant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense effect variant in surface types
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: v4 taxonomy lists 'grant_sense' as an effect atom, but it appears in no effect union in types.ts (not ClassFeatureEffect, not MasteryEffect, not ReactionEffect). Darkvision is precisely a sense grant — the only honest atom is grant_sense with a range parameter.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
